ACTION: Select a target within sensor range to remove 2 of its Evasive Pips, double its visibility and sensor signature, and disable its stealth. Effects decrease with target movement.

<color=#F79B26>Does not end your turn.</color>

动作：选择一个传感器范围内的目标，移除其2个闪避点，使其可见度与传感器信号翻倍，并解除其隐形。效果随目标移动而减弱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Call in a strafing run by the Argo's two aerospace fighters. Has a 2 turn cooldown! Costs 15 Resolve to use! Can only call in three strafes per contract! The fighters attack in two waves, one after another! Costs 50000 C-bills per use!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
ACTION: Do fancy footworks and barrel rolls to get rid of swarming Battle Armor. Lowers your accuracy by 6.

Base chance 30%
+5% per evasion gained, x1.2 if jumping
Maximum chance 95%

Base chance 45%
+5% per point of Piloting
Maximum chance 90%

每点驾驶技能+5%

+5% for each point of Piloting
-5% for each missing arm actuator

每缺失一个臂部驱动器-5%
主动: 从选定目标处进行补给

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: SPAMMY Bins contains ammunition supplies need for on-field ammo resupply. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Remote operation controls, automated systems, and fire control systems required to operate a drone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 操作无人机所需的远程操作控制器、自动化系统与火控系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Basic Sensors Suite. Thermal imaging, light amplification, radar and magnetic anomaly sensors are all among the primary sensors used by combat vehicles, supplemented by seismic sensors, motion detectors, chemical analyzers and a multitude of others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基础传感器套件. 热成像、微光增强、雷达和磁异常探测器是作战车辆使用的主要传感器，辅以地震传感器、运动探测器、化学分析仪等多种其他传感器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Drone Sensors Suite with a guard dog interface. Thermal imaging, light amplification, radar and magnetic anomaly sensors are all among the primary sensors used by combat vehicles, supplemented by seismic sensors, motion detectors, chemical analyzers and a multitude of others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套带看门狗接口的无人机传感器套件。热成像、光增强、雷达和磁异常传感器都是战斗车辆使用的主传感器，此外还辅以地震传感器、运动探测器、化学分析仪以及许多其他设备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Drone Sensors Suite with a 30 meter radius scan module. Thermal imaging, light amplification, radar and magnetic anomaly sensors are all among the primary sensors used by combat vehicles, supplemented by seismic sensors, motion detectors, chemical analyzers and a multitude of others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套无人机传感器套件，带30米半径扫描模块。热成像、光增强、雷达和磁异常传感器都是战斗车辆使用的主传感器，此外还辅以地震传感器、运动探测器、化学分析仪以及许多其他设备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ferret 'Catsnake' is armed with a Snubnosed PPC, 8 Blackwell Machine Guns, AP and HE ammo, and FCS Machine Gun. The Ferret is an advanced 45 ton attack Hovertank, with 10/15 move. It has no turret, its weapons are Front mounted. Standard equipment on all models includes: 7.75 tons of Reactive Armor, Recon Sensors, CASE, Laser AMS, Guardian ECM + IFF Jammer Mk1, Beagle Probe, Advanced Optics Mk1 and the unique quirk 'Slippery Customer'. Owning this item allows you to select an alternate hovertank when using the Cargo Vroom's unit deploy ability. Hold Shift while placing the unit after activating the deploy ability to select a unit from among those available.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雪貂"猫蛇"武装为一门短鼻PPC、8挺布莱克韦尔机枪、反人员与高爆弹药，以及火控系统的机枪模式。雪貂是一种先进的45吨攻击型悬浮坦克，移动力10/15。它没有炮塔，武器都装在正面。所有型号的标准装备包括：7.75吨反应装甲、侦察传感器、CASE、激光AMS、守卫者ECM + IFF干扰器Mk1、比格犬探测器、先进光学Mk1，以及独特的特性"滑不留手"。 拥有该物品让你在使用"货舱轰鸣"单位的部署能力时可以选择另一种悬浮坦克。 激活部署能力后放置单位时按住Shift，即可从可用单位中选择一个。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pirate Ferret is armed with 2 Medium PPPPPPulse lasers and 2 NARC Launcher (P) loaded with Explosive ammo. The typical LAMS has been deleted. The armor has been replaced with Reflective backed up with a Spall Liner. The Ferret is an advanced 45 ton attack Hovertank, with 10/15 move. It has no turret, its weapons are Front mounted. Standard equipment on all models includes: 7.75 tons of Reactive Armor, Recon Sensors, CASE, Laser AMS, Guardian ECM + IFF Jammer Mk1, Beagle Probe, Advanced Optics Mk1 and the unique quirk 'Slippery Customer'. Owning this item allows you to select an alternate hovertank when using Cargo Vroom's unit deploy ability. Hold Shift while placing the unit after activating the deploy ability to select a unit from among those available.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雪貂“舞刃”装有一门轻型AC/20、多种弹药类型和“破甲射击”火控。雪貂是一款先进的45吨攻击悬浮坦克，移动力10/15。它没有炮塔，武器均装在车首。所有型号的标准装备包括：7.75吨反应装甲、侦察传感器、CASE、激光反导弹系统、守护者电子对抗套件+IFF干扰器Mk1、比格犬探测器、先进光学Mk1，以及独特特性“滑不留手”。 拥有此物品后，使用货棚的部署能力时你可以选择另一款悬浮坦克。 激活部署能力后，在放置单位时按住 Shift，可从可用单位中选择其一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bluejay is a 0.5 ton UAV with a general purpose configuration. It carries a TAG, and a tiny combat load of a single droppable Thumper shell. It can EWS ping with a radius of 30 meters and feed data to C3 networks. 20 armor, 10/15 move, 150 meter fly height. It can EWS ping with a radius of 30 meters. Hold Shift while placing the unit after activating the deploy ability to select a unit from among those available.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金丝雀是一种0.5吨无人机，装备无人机电子战套件和隐形装甲。它没有任何可能提高其传感器信号的武器。它能以30米半径进行电子战套件探测。 < 激活部署能力后放置单位时按住Shift，即可从可用单位中选择一个。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Magpie is a 0.5 ton UAV equipped with TAG an ECM suite. It can feed information to C3 equipped allies. 20 armor, 10/15 move, 150 meter fly height. Hold Shift while placing the unit after activating the deploy ability to select a unit from among those available.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 0.5 ton UAV, it carriers a BA Medium Recoiless Rifle. It can feed information to C3 equipped allies. 0 armor, 9/14 move, 35 meter fly height. Hold Shift while placing the unit after activating the deploy ability to select a unit from among those available.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Two years after introducing their BattleMech Stealth Armor, the Capellan Confederation began experimenting with stealth armor for combat vehicles. In 3067 the armor reached the experimental stage. By 3084 advances in armor production for the Inner Sphere would allow this class of Stealth armor to enter limited mass-production.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在推出他们的战斗机甲潜行装甲两年后，卡佩拉联邦开始着手研究用于战斗车辆的潜行装甲. 到3067年，这种装甲已经进入实验阶段. 到了3084年，内天体装甲生产技术的进步使这一类型的潜行装甲得以进入有限规模的量产阶段.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Electronics Counter Measures system scrambles enemy targeting and missile systems and is an efficient upgrade to standard ECM equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套电子对抗措施系统扰乱敌方瞄准与导弹系统，是对标准ECM装备的高效升级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的能量运转，使用轻氢与氢作为燃料。 聚变引擎以其引擎额定值为规格。对机甲而言，引擎额定值是车辆质量与其期望最大行走或巡航速度的乘积。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Drone is equipped with both standard ECM and Probe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台无人机同时装备标准ECM和探测器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bloodhound Active Probe was first introduced by ComStar, using the Beagle Active Probe as a baseline for a suite of enhancement technology that, when attached to general electronic sensors, enables the equipped unit to detect and classify other battlefield units whether they are camouflaged or even shut down, with the exception of conventional infantry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 【Bloodhound Probe】血猎犬主动探头最初由ComStar研发，其以比格犬主动探头为基础，采用一系列增强技术. 当该设备连接至通用电子传感器后，可使装备单位探测并识别其他战场单位，无论目标处于伪装状态，甚至已经关闭系统，均可被发现，但传统步兵除外.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Battle Armor has greatly increased accuracy against the unit it is swarming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗装甲对它所蜂群攻击的单位命中率大幅提升。
驻防单位拥有防御加成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It turns out a single Thumper Artillery shell weighs less than the launch system of even something as tiny as a Battle Armor SRM. If you're flying right above enemies you can just drop stuff on them. Such simple, often field built, systems are difficult to aim.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 结果证明，一枚重锤炮弹的重量比连战斗装甲SRM这样微小的发射系统还轻。如果你在敌人正上方飞行，你完全可以把东西直接丢下去。这种简单、往往是战地自制的系统很难瞄准。
